evaluations.note: Lowered 23 -> 20 with AFTER_STAGNATION 4 -> 3 when common/lammps/Ecoh.in switched to exact captures (HPO reads Ecoh and the relaxed lattice constant back without rounding). With a 4-eval window, the warm-started re-evaluation of the incumbent RCUT2B = 6.000002 at eval 15 came out 4.5e-13 (relative) lower, counted as a new best, reset the window, and BFGS ended COMPLETED at eval 16 without a single restart. A 3-eval window fires at eval 14, before that re-evaluation, so both restarts run: 14 + 3 + 3 = 20. Best loss, components and RCUT2B are unchanged (1.003482e-01 at eval 11). RESTART RANDOM draws its restart points from std::random_device, so evals 15-20 differ from run to run; nothing pinned here depends on them: the best comes from the deterministic first launch (evals 1-14), and every restart stops after exactly 3 evals because no start in [4, 6] beats the incumbent at the upper bound (24 repeated runs: identical count, status, best loss and parameters).

tolerance_rationale: RESTART RANDOM seeds each restart from std::random_device, so the restart evaluations differ from run to run. Only values that do not depend on them are pinned: the best comes from the deterministic first launch, and each restart stops after exactly AFTER_STAGNATION evaluations because no start in the box beats the incumbent (see evaluations.note).
